The bank's commitment to sustainable social development was recognized at a Bengaluru event. J&K Bank has invested ninety-six crores in societal upliftment over three years. Its CSR programs focus on healthcare, education, and livelihood generation. The bank continues to expand its reach and deepen its social impact.
